question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Come what may.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The meaning of the idiom "***Come what may***" means '***No matter what happens***'. (कुछ भी हो जाए.)

 
 
• **Example**- We will go to the stage and give a presentation come what may.
 
 
 
• Idioms are phrases that are widely used in our daily lives.
 
• These phrases relate to situations that occur in our day-to-day life.

Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 2'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **To be among the latest** means something that is the most recent or currently fashionable. (नवीनतम के बीच होना)
 
• **To get frightened** means feeling fear. (रंग उड़ाना)
 
• **Meeting someone** means being introduced to or becoming acquainted with them. (किसी से मिलना)
